NATIONAL LIBRARY ACT 1972

NATIONAL LIBRARY (FEES AND FINES) (AMENDMENT) REGULATIONS 2015

IN exercise of the powers conferred by section 14 of

the National Library Act 1972 [Act 80], the Minister makes the following regulations:

Citation and commencement

1. (1) These regulations may be cited as the National Library (Fees and Fines)

(Amendment) Regulations 2015.

(2) These Regulations come into operation on 5 October 2015.

Substitution of First Schedule

2. The National Library (Fees and Fines) Regulations 1993 [P.U. (A) 295/1993],

which are referred to as the "principal Regulations" in these Regulations, are amended

by substituting for the First Schedule the following Schedule:
